name: Bug Catcher
unlock: Well done!
notes: Awarded by hand, never by play. The dirty diaper spent a day in the channel as an object the room listed and no verb reached, and eleven playtesters went at it with /look, /take and /use before the drop number was fixed. This is for them. Its trigger is registered and always says no, so nobody can stumble into it later.
